title: Crispy Vegetable Fritters
description: A delicious and crunchy snack made with a mix of vegetables, perfect for any occasion. These fritters are a great way to add some excitement to your meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
In a bowl, mix cornmeal, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped onion, sliced mushrooms, grated carrots, and grated zucchini to the bowl. Mix well.
Add the beaten egg to the bowl and mix until everything is well combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Carefully place the patties in the hot oil and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 4-5 minutes per side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
